notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where certain enemies would not die
 Fixed a bug where enemies could spawn out of bounds in Arena mode, preventing progress

notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra Patch 1.0.5
notes.content: Fixed the chapter warps in the Hub area

notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where a screen transition did not take place during Chapter 3
Fixed a bug where enemies could damage you after exiting a level

notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra Patch 1.0.3
notes.content: Moved save files to UserFolder...\Saved Games\ChronoBreach Ultra to solve issues with the game not saving for some users (Old save files will be moved automatically)

notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Minor performance improvements
Fixed a small bug regarding progression

notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra 1.0.1
notes.content:
Fixed Steam overlay not appearing for some users
 Fixed a bug when picking up a weapon
